title: NEWCASTLE LED FOR THREE MINUTES. NOW THE PRESSURE GROWS ON JAISSLE!
description:
Jacob Murphy's screamer lasted three minutes.

Newcastle drew 1-1 at Fulham. Murphy struck from long range in the 80th minute, and Rodrigo Muniz equalised in the 83rd. Fulham were the better side for much of the game, and a stoppage-time save from Lukas Hornicek stopped Newcastle losing a fifth league game.

The wider picture is the problem for head coach Matthias Jaissle. In early October Newcastle were six points clear of Fulham. Now they are twelfth on twelve points. At least it is tidy.

Pressure on Jaissle is growing, and the table is not helping.

Does he deserve more time, or is the pressure fair? Tell us where you stand in the comments.
